summary: Councillor Josh Matlow has submitted the following Administrative Inquiry: "I am submitting this Administrative Inquiry (under Municipal Code S27-61) to obtain clarification and information regarding the stated level of design completion by City and TTC Staff for the Scarborough Subway Extension at the July 12, 2016 meeting of City Council. During the Questions to Staff portion of the debate on EX 16.1 Developing Toronto's Transit Network Plan to 2031 at the July 12, 2016 Council meeting, Councillor Colle asks the Chief Project Manager for the Scarborough Subway Extension a question regarding the design completion status of the project (scroll to the 4 hour, 45 minute mark of the video linked in the attachment listed under Background Information below.) Councillor Colle: "And where would the subway be at design percentage of design completion? Around 5 (per cent) I think I've heard?" Chief Project Manager: "Uh, we're currently at about 5 per cent, yes." The Chief Project Manager's answer is reinforced by the chart from the Staff report presented at the July 2016 Council meeting which states that the cost estimate provided was "developed at approximately 5% design" (Chart is Table 3: Capital Cost Expenditure [Class 4 Estimate] [$millions], in the attachment listed under Background Information below.) These statements from City Staff contradict information provided by…
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, received Administrative Inquiry IA39.1 from Councillor Josh Matlow, Ward 22, St. Paul's regarding the Design Completion of Scarborough Subway Extension and Answer IA39.1a from the Interim City Manager, for information.

motions.desc: Majority required - IA39.1 - receive for information
